messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED @maria — canary eu-west-1 reporting elevated 5xx rate (avg 6.1% over 3m), health-check failures on model-serving pods, deploy wave 3.  Impact: ~4-6% of production traffic routed to canary.
maria: seeing it, joining. pulling logs now.
kevin: I can assist with rollback if you want to cut the release. status on DB migrations?
maria: no DB migrations in this release. it's model-change + runtime flags. suspect runtime hotpatch + quantized kernel combo.
sre_lead: tag runbook: runbooks/canary-5xx.md — follow abort criteria, threshold is 5% for 5m. we're past 3m at 6.1%.
nash: @maria do we have a fast feature toggle to divert traffic back to stable?
maria: yes — feature flag: feature.canary.routing.v2026-03. toggles available via control-plane. recommend safety-cutoff: set rollout_shares=0 for canary group.
kevin: ready to execute. will also pause autoscaler to avoid masking with new pods.
nash: run the toggle and then scale down canary deployment.
maria: executing toggle now: `curl -X POST https://control.internal/flags/feature.canary.routing.v2026-03 -d '{"rollout_shares":0}'` 
incident-bot: action logged by maria at 08:27 UTC — feature flag update applied.
maria: monitoring metrics... 5xx dropped to 1.2% within 45s. health probes improving.
sre_lead: good. mark abort criteria met and acted on. open ticket for postmortem and rollback decision.
kevin: agree - we should hold stable in prod and mark the canary deployment failed. I recommend full rollback of the canary image in the deployment history to previous stable to prevent accidental re-enable.
nash: canary pods still terminating, but traffic now mostly on stable. no customer-facing errors reported on top customers yet.
nash: noted small uptick in error logs for requests with long context lengths — correlate with quantization path.
maria: creating incident record: INC-2026-1851234567. assigning to eng-runtime + eng-ml for triage.
nash: adding tag: urgent, canary-failure, quantized-kernel.
kevin: leaving a note for morning rotation: do not re-enable feature.canary.routing.v2026-03 until eng-runtime signs off.
maria: handing off to @oncall_night — summary attached in INC-2026-1851234567. current state: safety-cutoff applied, traffic normal, 5xx < 1.5%.
oncall_night: acknowledged. will monitor next 2 hours and escalate if >2% 5xx or probe flaps.
sre_lead: thanks team. postmortem owners: eng-runtime (kevin), eng-ml (ashley). add eval prompt set to repro any quality differences. :thumbsup:
